newsitem.title: USA: Delphi and C-MAC enter development pact.
newsitem.headline: Delphi and C-MAC enter development pact.

text.p: Delphi Energy & Engine Management Systems and C-MAC Industries Inc said Tuesday they signed a five-year agreement to jointly develop and manufacture advanced electronic modules and systems for automotive applications.
The new products are "Smart Parts," or electromechanical sensing and actuating devices which have embedded electronics.
C-MAC integrates and packages high density microcircuits for reliable, maintenance free operation in extreme operating environments.
Delphi Energy & Engine Management Systems, based in Flint, Mich., is one of six divisions of Delphi Automotive Systems, a unit of General Motors Corp.

The division makes and markets systems and components to control the generation, conversion and storage of electrical energy, the flow of air and fuel into an engine, the combustion process, and cleanup of exhaust emissions.

C-MAC is an international supplier of advanced electronic components, sub-systems and systems for the telecommunication, automotive, instrumentation, defense and aerospace industries. The company is based in Sherbrooke, Quebec.
